mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with reduced discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve rate hikes that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with low housing starts (HOUST) indicates weak consumer demand, triggering negative market reactions due to reduced corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% and HOUST < 700.0 (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (high GDP growth and low unemployment), rising consumer demand (RSAFS) signals strong corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth (annualized) > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.0% and RSAFS > 400000 (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 700.0 (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading below 95.0 indicates a contraction in industrial output, signaling potential supply chain disruptions and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0 (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 225 combined with a federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative policy stance in the face of high inflation, which may lead to market concerns about future rate hikes, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime (characterized by a rebound in industrial production after a supply shock), rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals improving supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by more than 1.0% month-over-month and INDPRO declined by more than 2.0% in the previous 3 months (3-year rolling window).
